# IMSTEV NATURALS

> IMSTEV NATURALS is a Nigeria-based natural hair and skin care brand with a specialist-led salon in Bwari, Abuja.

## Primary local service

IMSTEV NATURALS provides natural hair care, styling, treatments, and protective styling for African hair textures. The salon serves clients in Bwari and the wider Abuja area through appointment-led care.

## Salon details

- Location: Bwari, Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria.
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday, 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM; Monday closed.
- Booking: https://www.imstevnaturals.com/salon-booking
- Local salon page: https://www.imstevnaturals.com/natural-hair-salon-abuja
- Phone: +2348110523763

## Other public services

IMSTEV NATURALS offers Hair Scan, Skin Scan, combined care scans, specialist consultation, telehealth consultation, custom formulation support, family care, Nigerian-made natural hair and skin care products, and a community for beauty journeys.
